review_snippet: Finally a size Large that actually fits, most brands run so small.
Comfortable for all-day wear, wore them to work and the gym same day.
Fabric started thinning after a couple months of regular wash.
Zero slipping during squats, actually tested this properly.
Compression is great but took a size up from my usual for comfort.
Good for training but a bit too warm for outdoor runs.
So soft, basically living in these after workouts now.
Great for lounging, wish there were more color options.
Nice fabric but the drawstring came loose within a month.
